title: 2023 — #09 — Shibby Live and Uncut (Podcast #09)
description: Welcome to my "Live and Uncut" podcast series. These files are a way for you to listen back on my past live recording sessions, and enjoy each of those experiences at your own leisure. It'll be casual, relaxed, and you'll get to hear me go through the process of voicing yet-to-be released files in their most raw and naked form, before they are cut out, to make the audios you all know and love. (There may still be some small edits made; eg. removal of longer sections of dead-air). Schedule New episodes will be released when available. Now, each month I try to do at least one live session, but schedules vary, as does my time, vocal health, and the kinds of scripts I have available to record. Unfortunately consistency is not always my strong suit, so there may be gaps, even significant gaps, between episodes depending on the year. Recording DateThis live recording took place on the 6th of August in 2023.
